title: Distribute Repeating Integers
description: Given an array of integers and an array of quantities, check if we can distribute the quantities among the counts of each unique integer in the array.
pseudocode:
1. countMap = getFrequencies(nums)
2. counts = Object.values(countMap)
3. quantities.sort((a,b) => b-a)
4. function backtrack(idx):
5.   if idx == quantities.length return true
6.   for i from 0 to counts.length - 1:
7.     if counts[i] >= quantities[idx]:
8.       counts[i] -= quantities[idx]
9.       if backtrack(idx + 1) return true
10.      counts[i] += quantities[idx]
11.  return false

steps.note: Count frequencies of input numbers [1, 1, 2, 2, 2], counts are [2, 3].
Attempt to place quantity 2 into count index 0.
Check if index 1 can hold quantity 1.
